From a post-merge code review of the batter-oj37 change (merged as d0064cdc), relevant to this issue; passed on as reported, not re-verified by me beyond reading the code path: (1) through TestClient::request a reused map also reaches operational_http_with_quota, which calls replace_quota on the inherited shared ObservationState, so the SOURCE request's completion event can report the destination's quota facts, in addition to the appended captures, concatenated MatchedPath and missing completion event already described here. (2) batter-axum's check, carries_routing_record in crates/batter-axum/src/boundary/client.rs, is private; batter-oj37's contract ruled out a second public entry point in batter-axum, so reusing it means either wrapping InProcessClient or a deliberate, recorded decision to expose a checking helper. (3) The same review confirmed with a throwaway test that a map carrying only Batter-private records (OPTIONS * map with OriginalUri removed) is accepted by InProcessClient with the earlier correlation id and no completion event; if this issue's fix refuses on Batter's own records for TestClient, the adapter client should get the same treatment so the two transports do not diverge.

fields.description: batter_axum::low_level::RouterClient::request (shared by InProcessClient and batter_runlimit::http::TestClient) detects only Axum routing records (RawPathParams record, MatchedPath, NestedPath, OriginalUri). A map that carries Batter's own ObservationState/OperationalScope (and CorrelationId) with no detected Axum record is accepted, and the observer and correlation layers keep the inherited records and install none. Reproduced by hand through TestClient on Axum 0.8.9 (gp93 branch, PR #117): a map captured in a protected custom root fallback for OPTIONS * carries OriginalUri as its only detected record; with OriginalUri removed by the caller the request is authenticated (1->2) and charged one native quota check (1->2), answers 200 with no x-request-id, the handler sees the client's unreplaced inbound x-request-id, and no completion event is emitted. The same residual applies to InProcessClient without the quota cost (batter-oj37 recorded it as out of scope). Batter's private record types live in batter-axum, so RouterClient could detect them at entry. Documented today on RouterClient::request, TestClient::request, guarantees (native quota execution, HTTP boundary) and integrations.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Decide whether the entry check also refuses requests carrying Batter's private observation/operational/correlation records (or another library-owned handling) without deleting application metadata; enforce it in RouterClient so both clients inherit it; cover the OPTIONS * fallback map with OriginalUri removed through InProcessClient and TestClient, including no quota consumed; update the residual statements in rustdoc, guarantees, integrations, READMEs and CHANGELOG; run scripts/verify.sh.
fields.title: Refuse or reset inherited Batter records in in-process requests

fields.description: batter_runlimit::http::HttpQuota::prepare orders batter_axum::low_level middleware itself (request_admission -> authentication -> native atomic quota -> body), because HttpBoundary cannot place an authenticated quota stage between admission and body extraction. As a result its TestClient holds a low-level RouterClient (gp93) rather than the sealed InProcessClient, and serving uses low_level::register_http_with_connect_info_in. Code review of gp93 raised the altitude point: a library-owned quota stage in HttpBoundary (or a route-group policy hook) would let Runlimit's assembly be a sealed boundary and drop its caller-ordered low_level composition. Evaluate under ADR-010; proposed, not designed.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Produce an ADR-010 assessment of whether HttpBoundary (or RouteGroup policy) can own an authenticated pre-body quota stage without weakening existing sealed-assembly invariants; if adopted, migrate HttpQuota to it with failure-path tests, CHANGELOG hard-cut notes as required, and verification; if rejected, record the evidence-backed reason.
fields.title: Express Runlimit's quota stage inside HttpBoundary so its client is a real InProcessClient

fields.description: A post-merge xhigh code review of the batter-oj37 change (master d0064cdc) found gaps to close in one follow-up PR. (1) The entry check looks only for Axum routing records, although batter-axum can name its own private request records. Reviewer-confirmed with a throwaway test: a map captured in the fallback of an OPTIONS * dispatch with the public OriginalUri removed is accepted; the destination answers 200 with the earlier request's correlation id, no x-request-id and no completion event. Decision: refuse such a request whole at entry as well (refusing, not clearing, stays within the batter-oj37 contract). (2) A live request forwarded by an outer Axum router into the client (Router fallback, route or nest_service closure) is now refused on every request; reviewer-confirmed. Decision: keep refusing, because that shape carries outer routing state and serves the boundary outside protected registration, but docs/guarantees.md still says the contract does not constrain 'an application's own transport wrapper' and the migration text covers only the stale-clone shape; state the rule and the migration. (3) CHANGELOG, guarantees and integrations claim the reference service's request client inherits the refusal with no executable test or unverified label. (4) The detection claim rests on Axum 0.8.9 internals while the crate's requirement allows later 0.8.x; record that it is verified for 0.8.9 only. (5) Documentation: the struct doc still says synthetic extensions are the caller's choice although a hand-inserted OriginalUri is refused; the refusal cannot be identified by status or body, only by the marker. (6) Test tidy: completions() is defined three times in tests/route_groups. COORDINATION: PR 117 (batter-gp93, another session) moves the entry check into low_level::RouterClient and rewrites the same rustdoc, docs and CHANGELOG passages, and documents item (1) as an uncovered residual; this work must be based on or rebased over it.
fields.acceptance_criteria: A request carrying any Batter-private request record with no detected Axum record is refused whole at entry with the same marker, before the router or application code is polled, with a failure-path test for the OPTIONS * map with OriginalUri removed and for a map captured behind a low_level wrapper; accepted requests and application extensions are unaffected. The forwarded-live-request refusal is pinned by a test and stated in rustdoc, contract documents and CHANGELOG with its migration. The reference service's client has a reused-map test and its rustdoc states the precondition. The Axum-version limit is recorded. Contract documents, status row, assessment and CHANGELOG agree with the code. Required verification runs and its outcome is recorded here.
fields.title: Close in-process entry-check gaps found in the post-merge review of batter-oj37
